pages.text: $(bold)Pyromancer - Heat$()$(br)Matching Fire casts add 10 Heat. Crossing 80 starts 5 seconds of White Hot; it cannot trigger again until Heat drops below 60. At 100 after that window, Overheat starts before decay and deals 2 HP of fire damage per second. Outside White Hot and Overheat, Heat decays by 0.10 per tick (2 per second). WATER casts remove 15 Heat and clear Overheat. Fire spell damage gains up to +60%, linearly with Heat. Pyromancer has no active release.

$(bold)Cryomancer - Frost Armor$()$(br)Taking a hit or casting matching Water adds 1 layer, up to 10. At 10 layers you suffer Slowness I until layers are released. Release Frost Nova from the Ascension Overview: all layers are consumed for a 2.4-6 block nova, dealing 1.5 damage per layer and applying slow and freeze to at most 12 nearby valid targets.

$(bold)Stormcaller - Charge$()$(br)Grounded, non-spectator movement over 0.05 blocks adds 5 Charge per block. A per-tick move above 1.5 blocks is treated as teleport-like and gives no Charge; other ineligible movement leaks 0.10 per tick (2 per second). Release Discharge from the Overview. It needs Charge and a valid target, consumes all Charge, and strikes up to 1-6 nearest valid targets within 10 blocks with visual-only lightning and 3-11 magic damage.

$(bold)Abysswalker - Hunger$()$(br)Hunger rises by 1 per second. Dealing damage lowers it by up to 10; kills lower it by 15, or 50 for bosses. At 100 Hunger, Devour deals 1.5 magic damage per second. Chaos spell damage gains up to +100% at zero Hunger, falling linearly to no bonus at 100. There is no active release.

$(bold)Earthshaper - Sediment$()$(br)Standing grounded adds 1 layer per second, up to 8. Each layer provides 5% damage reduction, capped at 40%. Grounded horizontal movement over 0.02 and at most 1.5 blocks per tick consumes all layers in a 2.375-5 block Topple, dealing 3 damage per layer and knocking back at most 12 nearby valid targets. Teleports and airborne displacement do not trigger it. This release is automatic, not an Overview button.

$(bold)Chronoweaver - Tempo$()$(br)Casting adds 5 Tempo, dealing damage adds 3, and taking damage adds 2. Tempo decays by 0.4 per second. Release Acceleration from the Overview for a fixed 40 Tempo: 6 seconds of Speed II, Haste II, and Resistance I.

$(bold)Aura Guard and Releases$()$(br)Aura Guard can be enabled or disabled from the Ascension Overview. Its state and all release requests are validated by the server. Successful Frost Nova, Discharge, and Acceleration releases have a 20-tick (1-second) server cooldown. Aura Guard cannot be toggled during tribulation or cultivation deviation; those states also force it off. Creative and spectator players are excluded from class-release damage.
